1.1: Moshe kibbel tora missinay, umesarah lihoshua, vihoshua lizkenim, uzekenim linviim, uneviim mesaruha leanshe cheneset haggedola. hem amru shelosha devarim, hevu metunim baddin, vehaamidu talmidim harebe, vaasu seyag lattora:
1.2: Shimon hatztzaddik haya mishsheyare cheneset haggedola. hu haya omer, al shelosha devarim haolam omed, al hattora veal haavoda veal gemilut chasadim:
1.3: Antignos ish socho kibbel mishshimon hatztzaddik. hu haya omer, al tihyu chaavadim hameshammeshin et harav al menat lekabbel peras, ella hevu chaavadim hameshammeshin et harav shello al menat lekabbel peras, vihi mora shamayim alechem:
1.4: Yose ven yoezer ish tzereda veyose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim kibbelu mehem. yose ven yoezer ish tzereda omer, yehi vetcha vet vaad lachachamim, veheve mitabbek baafar raglehem, veheve shote vetzama et divrehem:
1.5: Yose ven yochanan ish yerushalayim omer, yehi vetcha fatuach lirvacha, veyihyu aniyyim bene vetecha, veal tarbe sicha im haishsha. beishto amru, kal vachomer beeshet chavero. mikkan amru chachamim, kol zeman sheadam marbe sicha im haishsha, gorem raa leatzmo, uvotel middivre tora, vesofo yoresh gehinnom:
1.6: Yehoshua ben perachya venittay haarbeli kibbelu mehem. yehoshua ben perachya omer, ase lecha rav, ukene lecha chaver, veheve dan et kol haadam lechaf zechut:
1.7: Nittay haarbeli omer, harechek mishshachen ra, veal titchabber larasha, veal tityaesh min happuranut:
1.8: Yehuda ven tabbay veshimon ben shatach kibbelu mehem. yehuda ven tabbay omer, al taas atzmecha cheorche haddayyanin. uchesheyyihyu vaale dinin omdim lefanecha, yihyu veenecha chirshaim. ucheshenniftarim millefanecha, yihyu veenecha chezakkain, keshekkibbelu alehem et haddin:
1.9: Shimon ben shatach omer, heve marbe lachkor et haedim, veheve zahir bidvarecha, shemma mittocham yilmedu leshakker:
1.10: Shemaya veavtalyon kibbelu mehem. shemaya omer, ehov et hammelacha, usena et harabbanut, veal titvadda larashut:
1.11: Avtalyon omer, chachamim, hizzaharu vedivrechem, shemma tachuvu chovat galut vetiglu limkom mayim haraim, veyishtu hattalmidim habbaim acharechem veyamutu, venimtza shem shamayim mitchallel:
1.12: Hillel veshammay kibbelu mehem. hillel omer, heve mittalmidav shel aharon, ohev shalom verodef shalom, ohev et habberiyyot umekarvan lattora:
1.13: Hu haya omer, naged shema, aved sheme. udelo mosif, yasef. udelo yalef, ketala chayyav. udeishtammesh betaga, chalef:
1.14: Hu haya omer, im en ani li, mi li. uchesheani leatzmi, ma ani. veim lo achshav, ematay:
1.15: Shammay omer, ase toratcha keva. emor meat vaase harebe, veheve mekabbel et kol haadam besever panim yafot:
1.16: Rabban gamliel haya omer, ase lecha rav, vehistallek min hassafek, veal tarbe leasser omadot:
1.17: Shimon beno omer, kol yamay gadalti ven hachachamim, velo matzati lagguf tov ella shetika. velo hammidrash hu haikkar, ella hammaase. vechol hammarbe devarim, mevi chet:
1.18: Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, al shelosha devarim haolam omed, al haddin veal haemet veal hashshalom, shenneemar (zecharya 8) emet umishpat shalom shiftu beshaarechem:

2.1: Rabbi omer, ezohi derech yeshara sheyyavor lo haadam, kol shehi tiferet leoseha vetiferet lo min haadam. veheve zahir bemitzva kalla chevachamura, sheen atta yodea mattan secharan shel mitzvot. veheve mechashshev hefsed mitzva keneged secharah, usechar avera cheneged hefsedah. vehistakkel bishlosha devarim vei atta va lide avera, da ma lemala mimmecha, ayin roa veozen shomaat, vechol maasecha vassefer nichtavin:
2.2: Rabban gamliel beno shel rabbi yehuda hannasi omer, yafe talmud tora im derech eretz, sheyyegiat shenehem meshakkachat avon. vechol tora sheen immah melacha, sofah betela vegoreret avon. vechol haamelim im hatztzibbur, yihyu amelim immahem leshem shamayim, shezzechut avotam mesayyatan vetzidkatam omedet laad. veattem, maale ani alechem sachar harebe keillu asitem:
2.3: Hevu zehirin barashut, sheen mekarvin lo laadam ella letzorech atzman. nirin keohavin bishat hanaatan, veen omdin lo laadam bishat dachko:
2.4: Hu haya omer, ase retzono chirtzoncha, kede sheyyaase retzoncha chirtzono. battel retzoncha mippene retzono, kede sheyyevattel retzon acherim mippene retzonecha. hillel omer, al tifrosh min hatztzibbur, veal taamin beatzmecha ad yom motcha, veal tadin et chavercha ad shettaggia limkomo, veal tomar davar shei efshar lishmoa, shessofo lehishshama. veal tomar lichsheippane eshne, shemma lo tippane:
2.5: Hu haya omer, en bur yere chet, velo am haaretz chasid, velo habbayshan lamed, velo hakkappedan melammed, velo chol hammarbe vischora machkim. uvemakom sheen anashim, hishtaddel lihyot ish:
2.6: Af hu raa gulgolet achat shetztzafa al pene hammayim. amar lah, al daateft, atfuch. vesof metifayich yetufun:
2.7: Hu haya omer, marbe vasar, marbe rimma. marbe nechasim, marbe deaga. marbe nashim, marbe cheshafim. marbe shefachot, marbe zimma. marbe avadim, marbe gazel. marbe tora, marbe chayyim. marbe yeshiva, marbe chachma. marbe etza, marbe tevuna. marbe tzedaka, marbe shalom. kana shem tov, kana leatzmo. kana lo divre tora, kana lo chayye haolam habba:
2.8: Rabban yochanan ben zakkay kibbel mehillel umishshammay. hu haya omer, im lamadta tora harebe, al tachazik tova leatzmecha, ki lechach notzarta. chamishsha talmidim hayu lo lerabban yochanan ben zakkay, veellu hen, rabbi eliezer ben horkenos, verabbi yehoshua ben chananya, verabbi yose hakkohen, verabbi shimon ben netanel, verabbi elazar ben arach. hu haya mone shivchan. rabbi eliezer ben horkenos, bor sud sheeno meabbed tippa. rabbi yehoshua ben chananya, ashre yoladto. rabbi yose hakkohen, chasid. rabbi shimon ben netanel, yere chet. verabbi elazar ben arach, mayan hammitgabber. hu haya omer, im yihyu chol chachme yisrael bechaf moznayim, veeliezer ben horkenos bechaf sheniyya, machria et kullam. abba shaul omer mishshemo, im yihyu chol chachme yisrael bechaf moznayim verabbi eliezer ben horkenos af immahem, verabbi elazar ben arach bechaf sheniyya, machria et kullam:
2.9: Amar lahem, tzeu ureu ezohi derech yeshara sheyyidbak bah haadam. rabbi eliezer omer, ayin tova. rabbi yehoshua omer, chaver tov. rabbi yose omer, shachen tov. rabbi shimon omer, haroe et hannolad. rabbi elazar omer, lev tov. amar lahem, roe ani et divre elazar ben arach middivrechem, shebbichlal devarav divrechem. amar lahem tzeu ureu ezohi derech raa sheyyitrachek mimmenna haadam. rabbi eliezer omer, ayin raa. rabbi yehoshua omer, chaver ra. rabbi yose omer, shachen ra. rabbi shimon omer, hallove veeno meshallem. echad hallove min haadam, kelove min hammakom baruch hu, shenneemar (tehillim 37) love rasha velo yeshallem, vetzaddik chonen venoten. rabbi elazar omer, lev ra. amar lahem, roe ani et divre elazar ben arach middivrechem, shebbichlal devarav divrechem:
2.10: Hem amru shelosha devarim. rabbi eliezer omer, yehi chevod chavercha chaviv alecha keshellach, veal tehi noach lichos. veshuv yom echad lifne mitatcha. veheve mitchammem keneged uran shel chachamim, veheve zahir begachaltan shello tikkave, shenneshichatan neshichat shual, vaakitzatan akitzat akrav, ulechishatan lechishat saraf, vechol divrehem kegachale esh:
2.11: Rabbi yehoshua omer, ayin hara, veyetzer hara, vesinat habberiyyot, motziin et haadam min haolam:
2.12: Rabbi yose omer, yehi mamon chavercha chaviv alecha keshellach, vehateken atzmecha lilmod tora, sheenah yerushsha lach. vechol maasecha yihyu leshem shamayim:
2.13: Rabbi shimon omer, heve zahir bikriat shema uvattefilla. uchesheatta mitpallel, al taas tefillatcha keva, ella rachamim vetachanunim lifne hammakom baruch hu, shenneemar (Yoel b) ki channun verachum hu erech appayim verav chesed venicham al haraa. veal tehi rasha bifne atzmecha:
2.14: Rabbi elazar omer, heve shakud lilmod tora, veda ma shettashiv leeppikoros. veda lifne mi atta amel. veneeman hu vaal melachtecha sheyyeshallem lach sechar peullatech:
2.15: Rabbi tarfon omer, hayyom katzar vehammelacha merubba, vehappoalim atzelim, vehassachar harebe, uvaal habbayit dochek:
2.16: Hu haya omer, lo alecha hammelacha ligmor, velo atta ven chorin libbatel mimmenna. im lamadta tora harebe, notnim lecha sachar harebe. veneeman hu vaal melachtecha sheyyeshallem lecha sechar peullatecha. veda mattan secharan shel tzaddikim leatid lavo:

3.1: Akavya ven mahalalel omer, histakkel bishlosha devarim vei atta va lide avera. da meayin bata, ulean atta holech, velifne mi atta atid litten din vecheshbon. meayin bata, mittippa serucha, ulean atta holech, limkom afar rimma vetolea. velifne mi atta atid litten din vecheshbon, lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu:
3.2: Rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, heve mitpallel bishlomah shel malchut, sheilmale moraah, ish et reehu chayyim belao. rabbi chanina ven teradyon omer, shenayim sheyyoshvin veen benehen divre tora, hare ze moshav letzim, shenneemar (tehillim 1) uvemoshav letzim lo yashav. aval shenayim sheyyoshvin veyesh benehem divre tora, shechina sheruya venehem, shenneemar (Malachi 3) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vayyikkatev sefer zikkaron lefanav leyire Adonai ulechoshve shemo. en li ella shenayim, minnayin sheafillu echad sheyyoshev veosek battora, shehakkadosh baruch hu kovea lo sachar, shenneemar (Eicha 3) yeshev badad veyiddom ki natal alav:
3.3: Rabbi shimon omer, shelosha sheachlu al shulchan echad velo amru alav divre tora, keillu achlu mizzivche metim, shenneemar (yeshaya koach) ki kol shulchanot malu ki tzoa beli makom. aval shelosha sheachlu al shulchan echad veamru alav divre tora, keillu achlu mishshulchano shel makom baruch hu, shenneemar (yechezkel ma) vaydabber elay ze hashshulchan asher lifne Adonai:
3.4: Rabbi chanina ven chachinay omer, hanneor ballayla vehamehallech badderech yechidi vehamefanne libbo levattala, hare ze mitchayyev benafsho:
3.5: Rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana omer, kol hamekabbel alav ol tora, maavirin mimmennu ol malchut veol derech eretz. vechol happorek mimmennu ol tora, notnin alav ol malchut veol derech eretz:
3.6: Rabbi chalafta ven dosa ish kefar chananya omer, asara sheyyoshvin veoskin battora, shechina sheruya venehem, shenneemar (tehillim 82) elohim nitztzav baadat el. uminnayin afillu chamishsha, shenneemar (Amos 9) vaaguddato al eretz yesadah. uminnayin afillu shelosha, shenneemar (tehillim 82) bekerev elohim yishpot. uminnayin afillu shenayim, shenneemar (Malachi 3) az nidberu yire Adonai ish el reehu vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vegomer. uminnayin afillu echad, shenneemar (Shemot 20) bechol hammakom asher azkir et shemi avo elecha uverachticha:
3.7: Rabbi elazar ish bartota omer, ten lo mishshello, sheatta veshellecha shello. vechen bedavid hu omer (divre hayamim 1 29) ki mimmecha hakkol umiyyadcha natannu lach. rabbi shimon omer, hamehallech badderech veshone, umafsik mimmishnato veomer, ma nae ilan ze uma nae nir ze, maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitchayyev benafsho:
3.8: Rabbi dostay berabbi yannay mishshum rabbi meir omer, kol hashshocheach davar echad mimmishnato, maale alav hakkatuv keillu mitchayyev benafsho, shenneemar (Devarim 4) rak hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod pen tishkach et haddevarim asher rau enecha. yachol afillu takfa alav mishnato, talmud lomar (sham) ufen yasuru millevavcha kol yeme chayyecha, ha eno mitchayyev benafsho ad sheyyeshev visirem millibbo:
3.9: Rabbi chanina ven dosa omer, kol sheyyirat cheto kodemet lechachmato, chachmato mitkayyemet. vechol shechachmato kodemet leyirat cheto, en chachmato mitkayyemet. hu haya omer, kol shemmaasav merubbin mechachmato, chachmato mitkayyemet. vechol shechachmato merubba mimmaasav, en chachmato mitkayyemet:
3.10: Hu haya omer, kol sheruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu, ruach hammakom nocha hemennu. vechol sheen ruach habberiyyot nocha hemennu, en ruach hammakom nocha hemennu. rabbi dosa ven harekinas omer, shena shel shacharit, veyayin shel tzohorayim, vesichat hayeladim, vishivat batte chenesiyyot shel amme haaretz, motziin et haadam min haolam:
3.11: Rabbi elazar hammodai omer, hamechallel et hakkadashim, vehamevazze et hammoadot, vehammalbin pene chavero varabbim, vehammefer berito shel avraham avinu alav hashshalom, vehamegalle fanim battora shello chahalacha, af al pi sheyyesh beyado tora umaasim tovim, en lo chelek laolam habba:
3.12: Rabbi yishmael omer, heve kal lerosh, venoach letishchoret, veheve mekabbel et kol haadam besimcha:
3.13: Rabbi akiva omer, sechok vekallut rosh, margilin leerva. masoret, seyag lattora. maasrot, seyag laosher. nedarim, seyag lapperishut. seyag lachachma, shetika:
3.14: Hu haya omer, chaviv adam shennivra vetzelem. chibba yetera nodaat lo shennivra vetzelem, shenneemar (Bereshit 9) ki betzelem elohim asa et haadam. chavivin yisrael shennikreu vanim lammakom. chibba yetera nodaat lahem shennikreu vanim lammakom, shenneemar (Devarim 14) banim attem laAdonai elohechem. chavivin yisrael shennittan lahem keli chemda. chibba yetera nodaat lahem shennittan lahem keli chemda shebbo nivra haolam, shenneemar (Mishlei 4) ki lekach tov natatti lachem, torati al taazovu:
3.15: Hakkol tzafuy, veharshut netuna, uvetov haolam niddon. vehakkol lefi rov hammaase:
3.16: Hu haya omer, hakkol natun beeravon, umetzuda ferusa al kol hachayyim. hachanut petucha, vehachenvani mekif, vehappinkas patuach, vehayyad kotevet, vechol harotze lilvot yavo veyilve, vehaggabbaim machazirim tadir bechol yom, venifrain min haadam middato veshello middato, veyesh lahem al ma sheyyismochu, vehaddin din emet, vehakkol metukkan lasseuda:
3.17: Rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, im en tora, en derech eretz. im en derech eretz, en tora. im en chachma, en yira. im en yira, en chachma. im en bina, en daat. im en daat, en bina. im en kemach, en tora. im en tora, en kemach. hu haya omer, kol shechachmato merubba mimmaasav, lema hu dome, leilan sheanafav merubbin vesharashav muatin, veharuach baa veokarto vehofachto al panav, shenneemar (yirmeya 17) vehaya kearar baarava velo yire ki yavo tov veshachan charerim bammidbar eretz melecha velo teshev. aval kol shemmaasav merubbin mechachmato, lema hu dome, leilan sheanafav muatin vesharashav merubbin, sheafillu chol haruchot shebbaolam baot venoshvot bo en mezizin oto mimmekomo, shenneemar (sham) vehaya keetz shatul al mayim veal yuval yeshallach sharashav velo yire ki yavo chom, vehaya alehu raanan, uvishnat batztzoret lo yidag, velo yamish measot peri:
3.18: Rabbi eliezer ben chisma omer, kinnin ufitche nidda, hen hen gufe halachot. tekufot vegimatriot, parperaot lachachma:

4.1: Ben zoma omer, ezehu chacham, hallomed mikkol adam, shenneemar (tehillim kayit) mikkol melammeday hiskalti ki edvotecha sicha li. ezehu gibbor, hakkovesh et yitzro, shenneemar (Mishlei 16) tov erech appayim miggibbor umoshel berucho milloched ir. ezehu ashir, hassameach bechelko, shenneemar (tehillim 128) yegia kappecha ki tochel ashrecha vetov lach. ashrecha, baolam hazze. vetov lach, laolam habba. ezehu mechubbad, hamechabbed et habberiyyot, shenneemar (Shmuel 1 b) ki mechabbeday achabbed uvozay yekallu:
4.2: Ben azzay omer, heve ratz lemitzva kalla chevachamura, uvoreach min haavera. shemmitzva goreret mitzva, vaavera goreret avera. shessechar mitzva, mitzva. usechar avera, avera:
4.3: Hu haya omer, al tehi vaz lechol adam, veal tehi maflig lechol davar, sheen lecha adam sheen lo shaa veen lecha davar sheen lo makom:
4.4: Rabbi levitas ish yavne omer, meod meod heve shefal ruach, shettikvat enosh rimma. rabbi yochanan ben beroka omer, kol hamechallel shem shamayim basseter, nifrain mimmennu vegaluy. echad shogeg veechad mezid bechillul hashshem:
4.5: Rabbi yishmael beno omer, hallomed tora al menat lelammed, maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed. vehallomed al menat laasot, maspikin beyado lilmod ulelammed lishmor velaasot. rabbi tzadok omer, al taasem atara lehitgaddel bahem, velo kardom lachpor bahem. vechach haya hillel omer, udeishtammesh betaga, chalaf. ha lamadta, kol hannehene middivre tora, notel chayyav min haolam:
4.6: Rabbi yose omer, kol hamechabbed et hattora, gufo mechubbad al habberiyyot. vechol hamechallel et hattora, gufo mechullal al habberiyyot:
4.7: Rabbi yishmael beno omer, hachosech atzmo min haddin, porek mimmennu eva vegazel ushevuat shav. vehaggas libbo vahoraa, shote rasha vegas ruach:
4.8: Hu haya omer, al tehi dan yechidi, sheen dan yechidi ella echad. veal tomar kabbelu dati, shehen rashshain velo atta:
4.9: Rabbi yonatan omer, kol hamekayyem et hattora meoni, sofo lekayyemah meosher. vechol hamevattel et hattora meosher, sofo levattelah meoni:
4.10: Rabbi meir omer, heve memaet beesek, vaasok battora. veheve shefal ruach bifne chol adam. veim batalta min hattora, yesh lecha vetelim harebe chenegdach. veim amalta vattora, yesh lo sachar harebe litten lach:
4.11: Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, haose mitzva achat, kone lo feraklit echad. vehaover avera achat, kone lo kattegor echad. teshuva umaasim tovim, kitris bifne happuranut. rabbi yochanan hassandelar omer, kol kenesiyya shehi leshem shamayim, sofah lehitkayyem. vesheenah leshem shamayim, en sofah lehitkayyem:
4.12: Rabbi elazar ben shammua omer, yehi chevod talmidcha chaviv alecha keshellecha, uchevod chavercha kemora rabbecha, umora rabbecha kemora shamayim:
4.13: Rabbi yehuda omer, heve zahir battalmud, sheshshiggat talmud ola zadon. rabbi shimon omer, shelosha chetarim hem, keter tora vecheter kehunna vecheter malchut, vecheter shem tov ole al gabbehen:
4.14: Rabbi nehoray omer, heve gole limkom tora, veal tomar shehi tavo acharecha, shechaverecha yekayyemuha veyadecha. veel binatcha al tishshaen (Mishlei 3):
4.15: Rabbi yannay omer, en beyadenu lo mishshalvat harshaim veaf lo miyyissure hatztzaddikim. rabbi matya ven charash omer, heve makdim bishlom kol adam. veheve zanav laarayot, veal tehi rosh lashshualim:
4.16: Rabbi yaakov omer, haolam hazze dome lifrozdor bifne haolam habba. hateken atzmecha vapperozdor, kede shettikkanes latteraklin:
4.17: Hu haya omer, yafa shaa achat bitshuva umaasim tovim baolam hazze, mikkol chayye haolam habba. veyafa shaa achat shel korat ruach baolam habba, mikkol chayye haolam hazze:
4.18: Rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, al teratztze et chavercha vishat kaaso, veal tenachamennu beshaa shemmeto muttal lefanav, veal tishal lo vishat nidro, veal tishtaddel liroto vishat kalkalato:
4.19: Shemuel hakkatan omer, (Mishlei kad) binfol oyivcha al tismach uvikkashlo al yagel libbecha, pen yire Adonai vera beenav veheshiv mealav appo:
4.20: Elisha ben avuya omer, hallomed yeled lema hu dome, lidyo chetuva al neyar chadash. vehallomed zaken lema hu dome, lidyo chetuva al neyar machuk. rabbi yose var yehuda ish kefar habbavli omer, hallomed min hakketannim lema hu dome, leochel anavim kehot veshote yayin miggitto. vehallomed min hazzekenim lema hu dome, leochel anavim beshelot veshote yayin yashan. rabbi omer, al tistakkel bakkankan, ella vema sheyyesh bo. yesh kankan chadash male yashan, veyashan sheafillu chadash en bo:
4.21: Rabbi elazar hakkappar omer, hakkina vehattaava vehakkavod, motziin et haadam min haolam:
4.22: Hu haya omer, hayyillodim lamut, vehammetim lehechayot, vehachayyim liddon. leda lehodia ulehivvada shehu el, hu hayyotzer, hu habbore, hu hammevin, hu haddayyan, hu ed, hu vaal din, vehu atid ladun. baruch hu, sheen lefanav lo avla, velo shichcha, velo masso fanim, velo mikkach shochad, shehakkol shello. veda shehakkol lefi hacheshbon. veal yavtichacha yitzrecha shehashsheol bet manos lecha, sheal karchacha atta notzar, veal karchacha atta nolad, veal karchacha atta chay, veal karchacha atta met, veal karchacha atta atid litten din vecheshbon lifne melech malche hammelachim hakkadosh baruch hu:

5.1: Baasara maamarot nivra haolam. uma talmud lomar, vahalo vemaamar echad yachol lehibbarot, ella lehippara min harshaim shemmeabbedin et haolam shennivra vaasara maamarot, velitten sachar tov latztzaddikim shemmekayyemin et haolam shennivra vaasara maamarot:
5.2: Asara dorot meadam vead noach, lehodia kamma erech appayim lefanav, shekkol haddorot hayu machisin uvain ad shehevi alehem et me hammabbul. asara dorot minnoach vead avraham, lehodia kamma erech appayim lefanav, shekkol haddorot hayu machisin uvain, ad shebba avraham vekibbel alav sechar kullam:
5.3: Asara nisyonot nitnassa avraham avinu alav hashshalom veamad bechullam, lehodia kamma chibbato shel avraham avinu alav hashshalom:
5.4: Asara nissim naasu laavotenu vemitzrayim vaasara al hayyam. eser makkot hevi hakkadosh baruch hu al hammitzriyyim bemitzrayim veeser al hayyam. asara nisyonot nissu avotenu et hammakom baruch hu vammidbar, shenneemar (Bamidbar 14) vaynassu oti ze eser peamim velo shamu bekoli:
5.5: Asara nissim naasu laavotenu bevet hammikdash. lo hippila ishsha mereach besar hakkodesh, velo hisriach besar hakkodesh meolam, velo nira zevuv bevet hammitbachayim, velo era keri lechohen gadol beyom hakkippurim, velo chibbu geshamim esh shel atze hammaaracha, velo natzcha haruach et ammud heashan, velo nimtza fesul baomer uvishte hallechem uvelechem happanim, omdim tzefufim umishtachavim revachim, velo hizzik nachash veakrav birushalayim meolam, velo amar adam lachavero tzar li hammakom shealin birushalayim:
5.6: Asara devarim nivreu beerev shabbat ben hashshemashot, veellu hen, pi haaretz, ufi habbeer, ufi haaton, vehakkeshet, vehamman, vehammatte, vehashshamir, vehakketav, vehammichtav, vehalluchot. veyesh omrim, af hammazzikin, ukevurato shel moshe, veelo shel avraham avinu. veyesh omrim, af tzevat bitzvat asuya:
5.7: Shiva devarim baggolem veshiva vechacham. chacham eno medabber bifne mi shehu gadol mimmennu vechachma uveminyan, veeno nichnas letoch divre chavero, veeno nivhal lehashiv, shoel kainyan umeshiv kahalacha, veomer al rishon rishon veal acharon acharon, veal ma shello shama, omer lo shamati, umode al haemet. vechillufehen baggolem:
5.8: Shiva mine furanuyyot bain laolam al shiva gufe avera. miktzatan measserin umiktzatan enan measserin, raav shel batztzoret baa, miktzatan reevim umiktzatan seveim. gamru shello leasser, raav shel mehuma veshel batztzoret baa. veshello littol et hachalla, raav shel kelaya vaa. dever ba laolam al mitot haamurot battora shello nimseru levet din, veal perot sheviit. cherev baa laolam al innuy haddin, veal iuut haddin, veal hammorim battora shello chahalacha:
5.9: Chayya raa vaa laolam al shevuat shav, veal chillul hashshem. galut baa laolam al ovde avoda zara, veal gilluy arayot, veal shefichut damim, veal hashematat haaretz. bearbaa ferakim haddever mitrabbe, barviit, uvashsheviit, uvemotzae sheviit, uvemotzae hechag shebbechol shana veshana. barviit, mippene masar ani shebbashshelishit. bashsheviit, mippene masar ani shebbashshishshit. uvemotzae sheviit, mippene ferot sheviit. uvemotzae hechag shebbechol shana veshana, mippene gezel mattenot aniyyim:
5.10: Arba middot baadam. haomer shelli shelli veshellecha shellach, zo midda venonit. veyesh omrim, zo middat sedom. shelli shellecha veshellecha shelli, am haaretz. shelli shellecha veshellecha shellach, chasid. shelli shelli veshellecha shelli, rasha:
5.11: Arba middot baddeot. noach lichos venoach lirtzot, yatza secharo vehefsedo. kashe lichos vekashe lirtzot, yatza hefsedo vischaro. kashe lichos venoach lirtzot, chasid. noach lichos vekashe lirtzot, rasha:
5.12: Arba middot battalmidim. maher lishmoa umaher leabbed, yatza secharo vehefsedo. kashe lishmoa vekashe leabbed, yatza hefsedo vischaro. maher lishmoa vekashe leabbed, chacham. kashe lishmoa umaher leabbed, ze chelek ra:
5.13: Arba middot benotne tzedaka. harotze sheyyitten velo yittenu acherim, eno raa beshel acherim. yittenu acherim vehu lo yitten, eno raa veshello. yitten veyittenu acherim, chasid. lo yitten velo yittenu acherim, rasha:
5.14: Arba middot beholche levet hammidrash. holech veeno ose, sechar halicha veyado. ose veeno holech, sechar maase veyado. holech veose, chasid. lo holech velo ose, rasha:
5.15: Arba middot beyoshvim lifne chachamim. sefog, umashpech, meshammeret, venafa. sefog, shehu sofeg et hakkol. mashpech, shemmachnis bezo umotzi vezo. meshammeret, shemmotzia et hayyayin vekoletet et hashshemarim. venafa, shemmotzia et hakkemach vekoletet et hassolet:
5.16: Kol ahava shehi teluya vedavar, batel davar, betela ahava. vesheenah teluya vedavar, enah betela leolam. ezo hi ahava hatteluya vedavar, zo ahavat amnon vetamar. vesheenah teluya vedavar, zo ahavat david vihonatan:
5.17: Kol machaloket shehi leshem shamayim, sofah lehitkayyem. vesheenah leshem shamayim, en sofah lehitkayyem. ezo hi machaloket shehi leshem shamayim, zo machaloket hillel veshammay. vesheenah leshem shamayim, zo machaloket korach vechol adato:
5.18: Kol hamezakke et harabbim, en chet ba al yado. vechol hammachati et harabbim, en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. moshe zacha vezikka et harabbim, zechut harabbim taluy bo, shenneemar (Devarim log) tzidkat Adonai asa umishpatav im yisrael. yaravam chata vehecheti et harabbim, chet harabbim taluy bo, shenneemar (Melachim 1 15) al chattovt yaravam (ben nevat) asher chata vaasher hecheti et yisrael:
5.19: Kol mi sheyyesh beyado shelosha devarim hallalu, mittalmidav shel avraham avinu. ushelosha devarim acherim, mittalmidav shel bilam harasha. ayin tova, veruach nemucha, venefesh shefala, mittalmidav shel avraham avinu. ayin raa, veruach gevoha, venefesh rechava, mittalmidav shel bilam harasha. ma ben talmidav shel avraham avinu letalmidav shel bilam harasha. talmidav shel avraham avinu, ochlin baolam hazze venochalin baolam habba, shenneemar (Mishlei 8) lehanechil ohavay yesh, veotzrotehem amalle. aval talmidav shel bilam harasha yorshin gehinnom veyordin liver shachat, shenneemar (tehillim noah) veatta elohim toridem liver shachat, anshe damim umirma lo yechetzu yemehem, vaani evtach bach:
5.20: Yehuda ven tema omer, heve az kannamer, vekal kannesher, veratz katztzevi, vegibbor kaari, laasot retzon avicha shebbashshamayim. hu haya omer, az panim legehinnom, uvoshet panim legan eden. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettivne ircha bimhera veyamenu veten chelkenu vetoratecha:
5.21: Hu haya omer, ben chamesh shanim lammikra, ben eser lammishna, ben shelosh esre lammitzvot, ben chamesh esre lattalmud, ben shemone esre lachuppa, ben esrim lirdof, ben sheloshim lakkoach, ben arbaim labbina, ben chamishshim laetza, ben shishshim lazzikna, ben shivim lasseva, ben shemonim laggevura, ben tishim lashuach, ben mea keillu met veavar uvatel min haolam:
5.22: Ben bag bag omer, hafoch bah vahafoch bah, decholla vah. uvah techeze, vesiv uvele vah, uminna lo tazua, sheen lecha midda tova hemenna:
5.23: Ben he he omer, lefum tzaara agra:

6.1:
Shanu chachamim bilshon hammishna, baruch shebbachar bahem uvemishnatam:
rabbi meir omer kol haosek battora lishmah, zoche lidvarim harebe. velo od ella shekkol haolam kullo cheday hu lo. nikra rea, ahuv, ohev et hammakom, ohev et habberiyyot, mesammeach et hammakom, mesammeach et habberiyyot. umalbashto anava veyira, umachsharto lihyot tzaddik vechasid veyashar veneeman, umerachakto min hachet, umekaravto lide zechut, venehenin mimmennu etza vetushiyya bina ugevura, shenneemar (Mishlei 8) li etza vetushiyya ani vina li gevura. venotenet lo malchut umemshala vechikkur din, umegallin lo raze tora, venaase chemayan hammitgabber uchenahar sheeno fosek, veheve tzanua veerech ruach, umochel al elbono, umegaddalto umeromamto al kol hammaasim:
6.2: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, bechol yom vayom bat kol yotzet mehar chorev umachrezet veomeret, oy lahem labberiyyot meelbonah shel tora. shekkol mi sheeno osek battora nikra nazuf, shenneemar (Mishlei 11) nezem zahav beaf chazir ishsha yafa vesarat taam. veomer (Shemot 32) vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu charut al halluchot, al tikra charut ella cherut, sheen lecha ven chorin ella mi sheosek betalmud tora. vechol mi sheosek betalmud tora hare ze mitalle, shenneemar (Bamidbar 21) umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot:
6.3: Hallomed mechavero perek echad o halacha achat o fasuk echad o dibbur echad o afillu ot achat, tzarich linhog bo chavod, shekken matzinu vedavid melech yisrael, shello lamad meachitofel ella shene devarim bilvad, kerao rabbo allufo umeyuddao, shenneemar (tehillim noah) veatta enosh keerki allufi umeyuddai. vahalo devarim kal vachomer, uma david melech yisrael, shello lamad meachitofel ella shene devarim bilvad kerao rabbo allufo umeyuddao, hallomed mechavero perek echad o halacha achat o fasuk echad o dibbur echad o afillu ot achat, al achat kamma vechamma shetztzarich linhog bo chavod. veen kavod ella tora, shenneemar (Mishlei 3) kavod chachamim yinchalu, (Mishlei 28) utemimim yinchalu tov, veen tov ella tora, shenneemar (Mishlei 4) ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu:
6.4: Kach hi darkah shel tora, pat bemelach tochal, umayim bimsura tishte, veal haaretz tishan, vechayye tzaar tichye, uvattora atta amel, im atta ose chen, (tehillim 128) ashrecha vetov lach. ashrecha baolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba:
6.5: Al tevakkesh gedulla leatzmecha, veal tachmod kavod, yoter millimmudecha ase, veal titavve leshulchanam shel melachim, sheshshulchancha gadol mishshulchanam, vechitrecha gadol mikkitram, veneeman hu baal melachtecha sheyyeshallem lecha sechar peullatecha:
6.6: Gedola tora yoter min hakkehunna umin hammalchut, shehammalchut niknet bishloshim maalot, vehakkehunna beesrim vearba, vehattora niknet bearbaim ushemona devarim. veelu hen, betalmud, bishmiat haozen, baarichat sefatayim, bevinat hallev, besichlut hallev, beema, beyira, baanava, besimcha, betohora, beshimmush chachamim, bedikduk chaverim, uvefilpul hattalmidim, beyishshuv, bammikra, bammishna, bemiut sechora, bemiut derech eretz, bemiut taanug, bemiut shena, bemiut sicha, bemiut sechok, beerech appayim, belev tov, beemunat chachamim, uvekabbalat hayyissurin, hammakkir et mekomo, vehassameach bechelko, vehaose seyag lidvarav, veeno machazik tova leatzmo, ahuv, ohev et hammakom, ohev et habberiyyot, ohev et hatztzedakot, ohev et hammesharim, ohev et hattochachot, mitrachek min hakkavod, velo megis libbo vetalmudo, veeno sameach behoraa, nose veol im chavero, machrio lechaf zechut, maamido al haemet, umaamido al hashshalom, mityashshev libbo vetalmudo, shoel umeshiv, shomea umosif, hallomed al menat lelammed vehallomed al menat laasot, hammachkim et rabbo, vehamechavven et shemuato, vehaomer davar beshem omro, ha lamadta shekkol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam, shenneemar (Ester b) vattomer ester lammelech beshem mardochay:
6.7: Gedola tora shehi notenet chayyim leoseha baolam hazze uvaolam habba, shenneemar (Mishlei 4) ki chayyim hem lemotzehem ulechol besaro marpe. veomer (sham 3) rifut tehi lesharecha veshikkuy leatzmotecha. veomer (sham 3) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vetomcheha meushshar. veomer (sham 1) ki livyat chen hem leroshecha vaanakim legargerotecha. veomer (sham 4) titten leroshcha livyat chen ateret tiferet temaggenekka. veomer (sham 9) ki vi yirbu yamecha veyosifu lecha shenot chayyim. veomer (sham 3) orech yamim biminah bismovlah osher vechavod. veomer (sham) ki orech yamim ushenot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach. veomer (sham) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom:
6.8: Rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay omer, hannoy vehakkoach vehaosher vehakkavod vehachachma vehazzikna vehasseva vehabbanim, nae latztzaddikim venae laolam, shenneemar (sham 16) ateret tiferet seva bederech tzedaka timmatze. veomer (sham 20) tiferet bachurim kocham vahadar zekenim seva. veomer (sham 14) ateret chachamim ashram. veomer (sham 17) ateret zekenim bene vanim vetiferet banim avotam. veomer (yeshaya kad) vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma, ki malach Adonai tzevaot behar tziyyon uvirushalayim veneged zekenav kavod. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer, ellu sheva middot shemmanu chachamim latztzaddikim, kullam nitkayyemu verabbi uvevanav:
6.9: Amar rabbi yose ven kisma, paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech ufaga bi adam echad, venatan li shalom, vehechezarti lo shalom. amar li, rabbi, meeze makom atta. amarti lo, meir gedola shel chachamim veshel sofrim ani. amar li, rabbi, retzoncha shettadur immanu vimkomenu, vaani etten lecha elef alafim dinre zahav vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot. amarti lo, beni, im atta noten li chol kesef vezahav vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot shebbaolam, eni dar ella vimkom tora. velo od, ella shebbishat petirato shel adam en melavvin lo laadam lo chesef velo zahav velo avanim tovot umargaliyyot, ella tora umaasim tovim bilvad, shenneemar (Mishlei 6) behithallechcha tanche otach, beshachbecha tishmor alecha, vahakitzota hi tesichecha. behithallechcha tanche otach, baolam hazze, beshachbecha tishmor alecha, bakkever, vahakitzota hi tesichecha, laolam habba. vechen katuv besefer tehillim al yede david melech yisrael (tehillim kayit), tov li torat picha mealfe zahav vachasef. veomer (chaggay b) li hakkesef veli hazzahav amar Adonai tzevaot:
6.10: Chamishsha kinyanim kana lo hakkadosh baruch hu veolamo, veellu hen, tora kinyan echad, shamayim vaaretz kinyan echad, avraham kinyan echad, yisrael kinyan echad, bet hammikdash kinyan echad. tora minnayin, dichtiv (Mishlei 8), Adonai kanani reshit darko kedem mifalav meaz. shamayim vaaretz kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (yeshaya 66), ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay e ze vayit asher tivnu li vee ze makom menuchati, veomer (tehillim 104) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyanecha. avraham kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (Bereshit 14), vayvarchehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elyon kone shamayim vaaretz. yisrael kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (Shemot 15), ad yaavor ammecha Adonai ad yaavor am zo kanita, veomer (tehillim 16) likdoshim asher baaretz hemma veaddire kol cheftzi vam. bet hammikdash kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (Shemot 15), machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai mikkedash Adonai konnu yadecha. veomer (tehillim 78) vayviem el gevul kadsho har ze kanta yemino:
6.11:
Kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo, lo verao ella lichvodo, shenneemar (yeshaya mag), kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetzartiv af asitiv, veomer (Shemot 15), Adonai yimloch leolam vaed.

rabbi chananya ben akashya omer, ratza hakkadosh baruch hu lezakkot et yisrael, lefichach hirba lahem tora umitzvot, shenneemar (yeshaya 42) Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir:
